name: Tsuyuzaki Shin
source:
Shuka's childhood friend. He's a surgeon, and recently been quite concerned about the consecutive suicide cases among the youth. 

After talking with the yumegami Rushiru, he decided to leave for Germany to do more research relating to the matter there.
